page_title: BAR 1-0 CEL | Barcelona v Celta Vigo 22/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Jose Munuera is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Barcelona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
86' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
85' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
85' Great teamplay by Celta Vigo as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
84' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
81' Claudio Giraldez prepares a substitution. Fernando Lopez is replaced by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo).
81' Substitution. Ferran Jutgla will be replaced by Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo).
79' 3:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
76' Barcelona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
73' Hansi Flick decides to make a substitution. Ferran Torres will be replaced by Marcus Rashford (Barcelona).
73' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Dani Olmo and he is replaced by Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona).
72' It's time for a substitution. Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) comes on in place of Pablo Duran.
71' Neat passing move from Barcelona in order to create new attacking opportunities.
68' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) got the ball on the edge of the box and smashed a first-time shot, but his effort flew high over the crossbar.
67' A corner kick by Celta Vigo is thwarted by the well prepared Joan Garcia (Barcelona).
65' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging some short passes.
63' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) replaces Yoel Lago.
63' Here comes a substitution. Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) is brought on as a substitute for Hugo Alvarez.
63' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Barcelona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
59' Yoel Lago (Celta Vigo) has tested the patience of referee Jose Munuera and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
57' Celebrations are cut short for Barcelona as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
57' Wait! Referee Jose Munuera has indicated he is going to review the Barcelona goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
55' What an excellent finish! Ferran Torres (Barcelona) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and lashes the ball into the roof of the net. Unstoppable shot!
51' The statistic for corner kicks – 5:1.
49' Barcelona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

48' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
48' The attendance for today's match is 59034.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Hansi Flick gives a chance to Fermín (Barcelona) and Gavi is off.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+23' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+23' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

45+22' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed under the crossbar, but Ionut Radu was alert and made a comfortable save. The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
45+20' Yoel Lago (Celta Vigo) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Munuera no option but to blow his whistle.
45+19' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
45+17' The ball is out of play and Barcelona manage to earn a corner.
45+14' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
45+9' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Roony Bardghji replaces him.
45' We will have 8 min. of added time.
44' The game is interrupted.
41' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
40' 1 - 0 Goal! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Ionut Radu.
40' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
39' Yoel Lago (Celta Vigo) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Barcelona.
37' Lovely cross from Lamine Yamal to find Dani Olmo (Barcelona) deep in the box, but he steers his header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
35' A pass from Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) is intercepted by Joan Garcia and the move breaks down.
33' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
32' The foul by Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) was seen by Jose Munuera who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

29' Nice move, nice attempt! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
27' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
26' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' Substitution. Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) replaces Joao Cancelo.
21' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
20' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
19' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
15' Ionut Radu leaps to intercept the corner kick from Dani Olmo (Barcelona).
14' Now Barcelona have a corner.

14' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

11' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
8' Flag up against Dani Olmo (Barcelona). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
5' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Ionut Radu comes off the line to clear the ball away.
4' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
2' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Joan Garcia, who pulls off a stunning save!
1' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Celta Vigo.
1' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo), whose good effort would probably have ended inside the right post. Celta Vigo force their opponents to concede a corner.

1' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal! The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Celta Vigo will kick-off.
